findings.text: follow-on: the done-when states each case fails before the change, but the current-head case passes at the base arm (base-gate.log records 1 failed, the moved-head id only) and the moved-head case fails at base only on the absent reviewed_head key (the base classifier already read review-missing, not review-ready), so the reported review-ready-at-a-moved-head defect is exercised only by the declared negative control and not by the base arm.
